notes: New Privacy & telemetry tab: scans Windows for telemetry, advertising ID, lock-screen/Start suggestions, web-search tracking, activity history and more, shows each as Private or Exposed, and applies the recommended hardening in one click (with a System Restore point taken first). It also trims background noise that slows older PCs, and can post a summary to the ticket. Plus: the Drivers 'install all matching' job now shows a real progress bar and percentage instead of just 'Running', so you can see how far along it is.
